item.title: Sheepshead regulations to change March 1 in North Carolina
item.description: The N.C. Department of Environmental Quality’s Division of Marine Fisheries is reminding fishermen that new sheepshead regulations will take effect March 1 for both recreational and commercial fisheries.

item.title: Highsmith Road to close in Pender County for pipe replacement
item.description: The N.C. Department of Transportation will temporarily close part of a Pender County road beginning Monday for pipe replacement work.

item.title: Driver charged after crashing into Amtrak train at Rocky Mount crossing
item.description: A Rocky Mount man is facing charges after police say he drove around activated railroad crossing arms and collided with the side of an Amtrak train Wednesday afternoon.

item.title: Franklin Square Gallery in Southport celebrates fifty years of fine art
item.description: The Franklin Square Gallery in Southport is celebrating 50 years of exhibiting fine art. To commemorate this achievement, the Associated Artists of Southport ("AAS") are inviting new pieces of art and new artists to join the association, and the gallery.

item.title: More than 5,400 runners prep for 16th annual Wilmington Marathon
item.description: Thousands of runners from around the U.S. and the world are prepping Friday for the 16th annual Wilmington Marathon on Saturday.

item.title: Two arrested in connection with Carolina Beach Road shooting
item.description: Two people have been arrested in connection with a shooting last weekend on Carolina Beach Road that left one man seriously injured.

item.title: Crowds gather at Moores Creek National Battlefield for ‘First in Freedom’ festival
item.description: On Friday, history came alive at Moores Creek National Battlefield. The First in Freedom festival is underway, honoring a pivotal patriot victory in 1776.

item.title: Taking a look at the color and art of Minnie Evans

item.title: State Fire Marshal says working smoke alarms can help prevent death in fires
item.description: Working smoke detectors can easily help prevent death in case of a house fire.

item.title: “Outlander” author appears to help commemorate 250th anniversary of the Battle at Moores Creek Bridge
item.description: Diana Gabaldon appears at the Penderlea Auditorium to help celebrate the 250th anniversary of the Battle at Moores Creek Bridge
